title: Computational analysis identifies narrative patterns across 37 plays
summary: A computational analysis of 108,093 text records from 37 plays reports a decline in sentiment in later acts, genre-specific emotional arcs, thematic shifts and increasing network density. A random-forest genre classifier achieved 0.762 accuracy. The observations depend on this corpus and the authors’ operationalization; they do not establish author intent or patterns across all literature.
